title: FIFA President Infantino Faces Accusations and Legal Action Over Endorsement
summary: Jordan's FA chief accused FIFA president Gianni Infantino of blackmail over an endorsement deal, while UEFA confirmed a legal letter was served to FIFA regarding a World Cup plan. Five candidates are vying for the position of FIFA president after Infantino's term ends. The Jordan FA chief claimed Infantino threatened to withdraw Jordan from international football if they didn't endorse him.
summary_points: Jordan's FA chief accused Gianni Infantino of blackmail over an endorsement deal
UEFA confirmed a legal letter was served to FIFA regarding a World Cup plan
Five candidates are vying for the position of FIFA president after Infantino's term ends
